method.name: Integer Linear Programming with PuLP + CBC solver
steps: Define X, Y as integer LpVariables with bounds [0, 5000]

rationale: Small 2-variable integer program with linear constraints — direct ILP with CBC is the standard approach, verified on identical problem structure (orarla_6). Write output to result.json (sandbox requirement). Expect X=5000, Y=0, objective=50000.
